tools.description: Compute a difference map between two layers and visualize the result.
tools.name: calculate_layer_difference

layer_a.description: Display name or alias of the minuend layer.

layer_b.description: Display name or alias of the subtrahend layer.

geographical_area.description: Optional named area or 'current view'. Defaults to the current map view.

tools.description: Compute mean, standard deviation, and 25/50/75 percentiles for a layer over the current view, a named geographic region, or the full layer extent. Minor typos or paraphrased layer names are normalized automatically.
tools.name: calculate_layer_mean

geographical_area.description: Analysis scope: a named geographic region (for example 'Beaufort Sea'), 'current view', or canonical 'full layer extent'. Whole/full/entire-layer or full-raster requests must be normalized to 'full layer extent'.

layer_name.description: Layer display name or alias. Minor typos and paraphrased names are auto-corrected.

time_end.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp representing the end of the analysis window.

time_start.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp representing the start of the analysis window.

tools.description: Detect statistical anomalies in layer data using z-score and IQR methods. Identifies outliers, extreme values, and unusual patterns in geospatial datasets.
tools.name: detect_anomalies

layer_name.description: The name of the layer to analyze for anomalies (e.g., 'SWOT November 2024', 'ICESat-2 freeboard')

geographical_area.description: The geographical area to analyze (e.g., 'Beaufort Sea', 'Arctic Ocean', 'current view'). Defaults to current view if not specified.

method.description: The anomaly detection method to use. 'auto' uses both z-score and IQR methods.

threshold.description: The threshold for anomaly detection. For z-score method, this is the number of standard deviations (default 2.5).

time_start.description: Start time for temporal analysis in ISO format (e.g., '2024-11-01')

time_end.description: End time for temporal analysis in ISO format (e.g., '2024-11-30')

visualize.description: Whether to highlight anomalous regions on the map (default true)

tools.description: Summarize metadata for a specific layer by display name.
tools.name: describe_layer

tools.description: Remove the temporary highlight overlay.
tools.name: highlight_clear

tools.description: Adjust the opacity of the temporary highlight overlay.
tools.name: highlight_opacity

tools.description: Hide or show the temporary highlight overlay.
tools.name: highlight_toggle

tools.description: Provide metadata details for a requested MMGIS layer using local knowledge or web grounding.
tools.name: layer_information

layer_name.description: Display name or alias of the layer to describe.

original_query.description: Raw user query to echo for confirmation or paraphrasing.

tools.description: List which layers support advanced analysis (calculations, statistics, anomaly detection) vs visualization-only layers. Shows which data can be analyzed.
tools.name: list_analyzable_layers

tools.description: List all layers with their on/off state.
tools.name: list_layers

tools.description: Set a layer opacity in [0,1], clamped.
tools.name: set_layer_opacity

tools.description: Create a temporary highlight overlay by rescaling a numeric raster layer so values above, below, or between thresholds stand out.
tools.name: threshold_highlight

geographical_area.description: Optional named area to scope the highlight.

band.description: Optional one-based raster band index. Defaults to the layer's scalar/default band when omitted.

name.description: Optional label for the temporary overlay.

time.description: Single timestamp or label for the requested slice.

time_window.description: Relative window such as 'P7D' or 'past week'.

unit.description: Units for threshold values (e.g., m, cm, mm).

variable.description: Optional variable name within a multidimensional layer. Omit for a scalar/default raster band.

tools.description: Set the time for the map and all time-enabled layers. Accepts dates like 'February 2024', '2024-02-15', 'latest', etc.
tools.name: set_time

layers.description: Optional array of layer names to set time for. If omitted, sets time for all visible time-enabled layers.

tools.description: Toggle a layer visibility by display name. If visible=true show; false hide.
tools.name: toggle_layer

tools.description: Calculate per-layer summary statistics for multiple analyzable layers over the same requested area and present the results side by side.
tools.name: multilayer_statistics

layer_names.description: List of layer names to analyze (minimum 2 layers required)

geographical_area.description: The geographical area to analyze (e.g., 'Beaufort Sea', 'Arctic Ocean', 'current view'). Defaults to current view if not specified.

time_range.description: Optional time range for temporal analysis

include_visualization.description: Whether to show analysis area on map (default false)

tools.description: Analyze temporal trends in a layer over time, detecting seasonal patterns, long-term trends, and anomalous periods. Useful for climate change analysis and temporal pattern detection.
tools.name: temporal_trends

layer_name.description: The name of the layer to analyze for temporal trends (e.g., 'SWOT November 2024', 'ICESat-2 freeboard')

geographical_area.description: The geographical area to analyze (e.g., 'Beaufort Sea', 'Arctic Ocean', 'current view'). Defaults to current view if not specified.

time_start.description: Optional ISO start time. Supply the user's explicit start or a sanitized available layer/runtime start. When omitted, the renderer may use a configured layer availableStart; there is no fixed default.

time_end.description: Optional ISO end time. Supply the user's explicit end or a sanitized available layer/runtime end. When omitted, the renderer may use a configured layer availableEnd; there is no fixed default.

tools.description: Calculate descriptive spatial autocorrelation using Moran's I, Gi* hotspot/coldspot candidate scores, and high/low neighbor-cluster counts on an aggregated raster grid.
tools.name: spatial_statistics

layer_name.description: The name of the layer to analyze for spatial patterns (e.g., 'SWOT November 2024', 'ICESat-2 freeboard')

geographical_area.description: The geographical area to analyze (e.g., 'Beaufort Sea', 'Arctic Ocean', 'current view'). Defaults to current view if not specified.

grid_size.description: Grid size for spatial analysis (default 16). Larger values provide more detailed analysis.

visualize.description: Whether to highlight analysis area and patterns on the map (default true)

tools.description: Compare raster samples from two time periods and report descriptive changes in summary values plus aligned spatial increase/decrease patterns when available.
tools.name: change_detection

layer_name.description: The name of the layer to analyze for changes (e.g., 'SWOT November 2024', 'ICESat-2 freeboard')

geographical_area.description: The geographical area to analyze (e.g., 'Beaufort Sea', 'Arctic Ocean', 'current view'). Defaults to current view if not specified.

before_time.description: Start time for 'before' period in ISO format (e.g., '2024-01-01'). Defaults to '2024-01-01'.

after_time.description: End time for 'after' period in ISO format (e.g., '2024-12-01'). Defaults to '2024-12-01'.

threshold.description: Absolute per-pixel difference cutoff, in the layer's units, used to classify aligned pixels as stable versus increasing or decreasing (default 0.1).

visualize.description: Whether to highlight change area on map with color indicating increase/decrease (default true)

tools.description: Create temporal animations showing ice evolution over time. Provides playback controls and frame-by-frame visualization of changes.
tools.name: time_series_animation

layer_name.description: The name of the layer to animate (e.g., 'SWOT freeboard', 'ICESat-2 thickness')

time_start.description: Start time for animation in ISO format (e.g., '2024-01-01'). Defaults to '2024-01-01'.

time_end.description: End time for animation in ISO format (e.g., '2024-12-31'). Defaults to '2024-12-31'.

frame_rate.description: Milliseconds per frame (default 1000ms). Lower values = faster animation.

auto_play.description: Whether to automatically start playing the animation (default false)

tools.description: Export selected data for external analysis as CSV, GeoJSON, KML, or JSON.
tools.name: data_export

layer_name.description: The name of the layer to export (e.g., 'SWOT November 2024', 'ICESat-2 freeboard')

geographical_area.description: The geographical area to export (e.g., 'Beaufort Sea', 'current view'). Defaults to current view.

resolution.description: Data resolution for export (default 'medium'). Lower resolution = smaller file size.

include_metadata.description: Whether to include metadata in the export (default true)

auto_download.description: Whether to automatically trigger file download (default false)

time_range.description: Optional time range for temporal filtering

tools.description: Zoom to a named region, lon/lat and zoom level, or a bbox.
tools.name: zoom_to

region.description: Named geographic region to resolve, such as Beaufort Sea.

tools.name: statistics_first_visible
tools.description: Find the first currently visible layer that exposes analyzable scalar values, calculate its statistics in the requested area, and explain why incompatible imagery layers are skipped.

geographical_area.description: Named region or 'current view'. Defaults to the current view.

tools.name: highlight_relative_to_mean
tools.description: Calculate a compatible layer's mean and highlight scalar values above or below that computed mean. If no layer is named, use the first visible analyzable layer.

layer_name.description: Optional layer display name or alias.

geographical_area.description: Named region or 'current view'. Defaults to the current view.

direction.description: Whether to highlight values above or below the computed mean.

tools.name: open_animation_tool
tools.description: Open the Animation Tool and provide a manual handoff for the requested layer, time range, region, and format. Copilot does not apply those panel inputs; the user must select them, draw export bounds, and start the GIF or MP4 export.

layer_name.description: Requested layer display name included in the manual handoff; the user selects it in the panel.

start_date.description: Optional requested ISO start date included in the handoff; it is not applied automatically.

end_date.description: Optional requested ISO end date included in the handoff; it is not applied automatically.

region.description: Optional requested region included in the handoff; the user still draws export bounds.

format.description: Preferred manual export format included in the handoff instructions (default: 'gif').
